dataset_rule: Clinic-first public-price audit. Every numeric-priced treatment/service captured from the reviewed official public price pages is included, not only flagship Explore categories.
limitations: Best-effort public-web snapshot; hidden, private, booking-only, JavaScript-only, image-only, or consultation-only prices may be absent.
Rows without a numeric public price are omitted rather than estimated.
Ratings are null unless a reviewed public source supplied a rating; this snapshot does not import third-party ratings.
For pages presenting several prices in one text row, each numeric option is retained and the original price text is preserved in price_note.
National clinic groups are included only where they operate a London location; branches are grouped under one clinic business.
The 100+ expansion preserves the original 62-clinic snapshot and adds 39 distinct businesses from reviewed public numeric price pages.
